resolved_verification_issues.cause: The stripped PATH omitted basename/ln/env used before PR reading, so the fixture failed in setup.
resolved_verification_issues.resolution: Used the real reader with an intentionally invalid token only in its child environment; restored the existing token for the successful retry. No installed CLI or login was changed.

resolved_verification_issues.cause: The real dcg guard exceeded its 200 ms evaluation budget (215 ms) while judging an empty marker-directory removal; the product stopped and retained recovery.
resolved_verification_issues.resolution: Drove a fresh real disposable Git worktree with the usual .git file and unchanged dcg guard; staging and expiry passed. The refused command was not retried or bypassed.
